description: One model in depth: specs (creator, origin, tier, license, context window, output limit, training cutoff, modalities), the Attic Standard indexes it belongs to, and its price at every vendor. Free tier returns counts, ranges and redacted samples; Attic Standard MCP PRO ($500/month, https://atticstandard.com/mcp) returns vendor names, model names and exact prices.

_atom_api_key.description: Your Attic Standard MCP PRO key for vendor- and SKU-level data. Omit for the free tier.
